import numpy as np
# Baseline subtraction using points at 1100 and 1800 cm-1 (+/- 10 cm-1 average)
mask_1100 = (x >= 1090) & (x <= 1110)
mask_1800 = (x >= 1790) & (x <= 1810)
if mask_1100.any() and mask_1800.any():
    y_base_1100 = np.mean(y1[mask_1100])
    y_base_1800 = np.mean(y1[mask_1800])
    # Linear baseline equation: y = m*x + c
    slope = (y_base_1800 - y_base_1100) / (1800 - 1100)
    intercept = y_base_1100 - slope * 1100
    baseline = slope * x + intercept
    y1_bl = y1 - baseline
else:
    y1_bl = y1.copy()

# Normalize so that max intensity in G band (1550-1620 cm-1) is 1
mask_g = (x >= 1550) & (x <= 1620)
if mask_g.any():
    g_max = np.max(y1_bl[mask_g])
    if g_max != 0:
        y1_norm = y1_bl / g_max
    else:
        y1_norm = y1_bl
else:
    y1_norm = y1_bl

y1 = y1_norm
